run_agent_background: run an agent graph in the background and publish streaming events to a bridge
run_agent_with_rollback: run an agent with checkpoint rollback on user cancellation or error
run_agent_with_stream_modes: run an agent graph with multiple LangGraph stream modes like values and messages
rollback_pre_run_checkpoint: rollback a thread's checkpoint state to the snapshot captured before agent execution
unpack_stream_item: unpack a multi-mode or subgraph stream item into mode and chunk tuples
